scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic derivation; exhaustive even-partition verification. Prior frustration-index value credited rather than claimed new. The minimum 24 and 16/16 optimal-field profile were known in 1979 and are fully credited.
scientific_limitations: Specific to the 32-vertex five-cube and zero magnetic field. No independent validation. Historical priority provisional subject to nonindexed literature.
title: Exact energy partition polynomial of the fully frustrated five-cube
